'''Hayde Gofai''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] club-hopper from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she socialized with the fellow Human [[Sne Wo]] at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on Coruscant when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered, searching for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. She looked for a date in Skywalker, fixing a bold gaze to him, but unfortunately for her, he was looking for Wesell and not romance.

==Biography==
Hayde Gofai was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] native to<ref name="DB" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DB" /> She<ref name="Insider" /> was a club-hopping<ref name="DB" /> participator in Coruscant's party scene.<ref name="Rogues Gallery">{{InsiderCite|136|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: A Night at the Outlander Club}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Gofai visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="EpII" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of her homeworld,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> during the [[Local day/Legends|night]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. She walked and conversed at the club, drinks in hand, with the fellow Human<ref name="EpII" /> [[Sne Wo]]<ref name="Insider" /> when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered, searching for Wesell<ref name="EpII" /> 

The pair of women<ref name="Insider" /> moved toward the entrance of the club then stood there as Gofai stared at the Padawan from behind.<ref name="EpII" /> She could not help but notice Skywalker as he surveyed the crowd in the club.<ref name="IntriguedExtras">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/05/imageattack20030529.html|series=Image Attack|text=Intrigued Extras}}</ref> Later, she chatted with Wo<ref name="EpII" /> before trying her [[luck]] with Skywalker.<ref name="FF96">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> She affixed a bold, seductive gaze<ref name="Insider" /> to him as he passed by.<ref name="FF96" /> Unfortunately for her, he was looking for Wesell and not a date.<ref name="Insider" /> The bounty hunter was later captured and removed from the club.<ref name="EpII" />

==Personality and traits==
Gofai, a thrill seeker<ref name="DB" /> who was not shy, was romantically interested in Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="Insider" /> She was thought of as beautiful,<ref name="Insider" /> had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="EpII" /> light skin and blonde [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="DB" /> Her feminine first name and her surname were of Human origin.<ref name="GalacticCampaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
At the club, she wore a black [[Clothing/Legends|bikini]], small black shorts, a sleeveless sheer blue cloak,<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> blue lipstick,<ref name="DepthCommentary">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> black heels, and small stars on her face and body.<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Viewers can see the blue-lipped beauty several more times as the host of the "Production Offices" and "George Lucas in Lunch" segments of the ''On Location [sic]'' webisode series available at starwars.com.|[[Daniel Wallace]], on the extra playing Hayde Gofai|<ref name="Insider" />}}
[[File:HaydeGofai-AOTC1.png|thumb|right|300px|Hayde Gofai made one of her first appearances in ''Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones'' 1.]]
Hayde Gofai appeared, portrayed by an uncredited extra, in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], during the Outlander Club scenes<ref name="EpII" /> shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The extra, in costume, introduced the first episode of the Episode II behind-the-scenes video series [[On location|''on location'']],<ref name="On location 1">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/1.html|series=On Location|text=Part 1 - Production Offices}}</ref> "Production Offices," and later the eighth episode, "George Lucas in Lunch," with other extras.<ref name="On location 8">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/8.html|series=On Location|text=Part 8 - George Lucas in Lunch}}</ref> The episodes released on [[August 1]], 2000, and [[September 19]], 2000, respectively.<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/archive.html|text=''on location'' archive}}</ref> 

The character first appeared in both the [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 1|first issue]] of the film's [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones (comic series)|comic adaptation]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]] and written by [[Henry Gilroy]],<ref name="AOTCComic">[[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 1|''Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones'' 1]]</ref> and in the film's [[Mighty Chronicles]] [[Attack of the Clones (Mighty Chronicles)|adaptation]], written by [[John Whitman]] and illustrated by [[Brandon McKinney]]. Both works released on [[April 23]], 2002,<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/00-468/Star-Wars-Episode-II----Attack-of-the-Clones-1|text=Star Wars: Episode II -- Attack of the Clones #1}}</ref><ref name="Preview">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/release/publish/news20020211.html|text=Book Preview: Mighty Chronicles}}</ref> before Episode II's [[May 16]], 2002, premiere.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The character was later first identified the Episode II [[Depth Commentary]] available on [[StarWars.com]] and accessible through the DVD-ROM home release of ''Attack of the Clones''<ref name="DepthCommentary" /> on [[November 12]], 2002.<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref>
